quote: If a laned roadway is restricted to one direction, a person shall not stand or park a vehicle upon the left-hand side of such one-way roadway unless official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking.

activation.condition: A laned roadway is restricted to one direction and the person stands or parks a vehicle on its left-hand side.

obligation.description: Do not stand or park a vehicle on the left-hand side of that one-way roadway in the absence of the source exception.

exceptions.trigger: Official traffic-control devices are erected permitting the standing or parking at the governed location.
exceptions.effect: The stated prohibition does not apply to the permitted standing or parking.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: No replacement obligation is stated in this section.
exceptions.source_clause: unless official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking

timing.description: Assess the original standing or parking interval.

parameter_refs.name: requested_left_parking_permission_device
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested present or absent; actual official status remains source-review dependent

parameter_refs.name: observed_official_governing_permission
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original evidence of official erection, governance, and permission or unknown
